news.title: Sebi asks stock brokers to display investor warnings on apps and websites
news.description: Sebi orders stock brokers to display investor awareness messages on websites and trading apps under Project Jagrook. From November 1, apps must show Sebi messages and risk disclosures on alternate days, strengthening digital investor education and risk communication.
